description: REopt is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by The National Renewable Energy Laboratory. The REopt™ model provides concurrent, multiple technology integration and optimization capabilities to help organizations meet their cost savings and energy performance goals. Coverage: World. The fact sheet classes it as: Energy System Model. Sectors: Energy. Resolution: time Hour, geography Site. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is BSD-3-Clause (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
